svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP','PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei','Hiragino Sans',system-ui,sans-serif
svg.title: Japan's tax-free shopping procedures compared: the tax-free method through 2026/10/31 and pay first, refund later from 11/1
svg.desc: The upper row shows the current system: present your passport at a tax-free shop, buy at the tax-free price, keep consumables sealed, obtain customs confirmation in the restricted area after security on departure, then board. The lower row shows the refund system starting 2026/11/1: pay the tax-inclusive price at a tax-free shop and register your refund method. On departure, before security and baggage check-in, scan your passport at a self-service kiosk or through Visit Japan Web. Green means confirmation is complete; red means customs inspection is required and you must present the goods. The tax-free shop or refund operator issues the refund after customs confirmation. Confirmation must be completed within 90 days of purchase. The 5,000 yen pre-tax threshold remains unchanged. The distinction between general goods and consumables, the cap of 50 × ten thousand yen, and sealed packaging are abolished. Consumables used in Japan receive no refund.
svg.text: Japan tax-free shopping: current system vs. pay first, refund later from 2026/11/1
Tax-free shopping in Japan, before and after 1 Nov 2026 · Compiled from Japan Tourism Agency and National Tax Agency announcements; verified in 2026/9
Through 2026/10/31: current system (tax-free method / Tax-free at the till)

svg.text: The sale date determines the system: purchases from midnight on 11/1 use refunds; purchases through 10/31 follow the old system. No parallel transition period.
